primitives.name: Equicontinuous Indefinite Integrals
primitives.verbatim_quote: A sequence {fn} of integrable functions converges in the mean to the integrable function f if and only if {fn} converges in measure to f and the indefinite integrals of |fn |, n = 1, 2, ..., are uniformly absolutely continuous and equicontinuous from above at O.

primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure of uniform absolute continuity or equicontinuity at zero.
